## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-9d4d0b29)

## Summary

`docs/reviews/rev43-producers.md` finding 8b: two installation authority writers were dead — `CadInstallationContextRepository.save_context` and the InstallationDatum save path had no UI route — while real consumers (R110 source evaluation, 設置ハンドオフ export, overview 設置 domain) already read persisted records. This PR adds the registration surfaces so operators can actually record both artifacts.

**Speaker installation context** — new `InstallationPanel` section on the 部屋 workspace スピーカー・座席 (placement) context: equipment pick restricted to persisted `EquipmentDefinition`s (name+version, hash-pinned); mounting-mode combo restricted to the selected definition's declared modes (fail-closed to 未記録 when none are declared); host-entity pick (walls + entities, excluding the speaker itself); baffle state; measured clearances + unique-axis overrides; directivity applicability with the rationale field gated on non-default selection; provenance (recorded actor + optional evidence ref). Save → `save_context`; the persisted chain is listed per entity (append-only — a second save shows both entries) and the latest context is re-evaluated via `evaluate_installation_context` with per-check results shown inline. `CadInstallationContextRepository.list_contexts_for_entity` added for the honest chain view.

**Installation datum** — same panel's 設置基準（データム）section: pinned `SceneRevision` pick (defaults to head, required because the handoff export auto-discovers the datum only for the exported revision), frame semantics labels, primary anchor (vertex or wall pick), distinct x/y direction wall picks, evidence refs, notes → `build_installation_datum` → `save_datum`. Registered datums are listed with freshness vs current head.

**Fail-closed**: missing speaker/equipment/actor, non-default directivity without rationale, duplicate override axes, self-mounting host, unpersisted equipment, non-distinct direction walls, and rooms without wall topology all surface JA inline errors (or a disabled save + hint) — nothing writes a partial record.

## Consumers verified end-to-end (real GUI)

- R110 source evaluation picks up the persisted context via `get_context_for_entity` (mounting/baffle folded into the radiation model — covered by test asserting `model.installation_context_sha256` equals the latest chain entry).
- Overview 設置 domain went `0/3 スピーカー` → `1/3 スピーカー` after one context save.
- 設置ハンドオフ preview shows `設置基準: 利用可能` for the pinned revision after a datum save.

## Tests

`backend/tests/test_rev44_install_surfaces.py` — register→consumer sees it (context → R110 sha256 + overview count; datum → handoff 設置基準 AVAILABLE + stale-revision authority error), cancel/fail-closed paths (no actor, iec_baffle without rationale, duplicate axes, self-host, unpersisted equipment, same x/y wall, no wall topology), authority-chain listing, and the workspace mount. Scoped run: 65/65 green.

## Intentionally manual

- Directivity rationale rides as a second `EquipmentDataProvenance` entry (`directivity:{mode}:{rationale}`) — `SpeakerInstallationContext` has no dedicated rationale field; reusing provenance keeps the record honest without changing the authority model.
- One datum chain per document (`datum-{document_id}`) with incrementing versions — matches the append-only version model; a new scene revision warrants a new datum version pinned to it.
